scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Nirman Shramikon Ke Bachon Hetu Nihshulk Coaching Sahaayata Yojana
description:
The Mukhyamantri Nirman Shramikon Ke Bachon Hetu Nihshulk Coaching Sahaayata Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Madhya Pradesh in India. 

This scheme was launched on 1st August 2021. 

It aims to provide free coaching assistance to the children of construction workers. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to enhance the educational opportunities for the children of laborers engaged in the construction sector. 

The government recognizes that children of construction workers often face educational disadvantages due to their parents' financial constraints. 

Thus, the scheme aims to bridge this gap by providing free coaching for competitive examinations. 

The targeted competitive examinations include those for medical and engineering colleges. 

The scheme also covers coaching for other professional courses. 

The government has set a measurable target of benefiting at least 10,000 children annually through this initiative. 

The total budget allocated for the scheme is approximately ₹10 crore. 

Each child enrolled under this scheme is eligible for coaching assistance of up to ₹50,000. 

This amount can be utilized for tuition fees, study materials, and other educational expenses. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are specific and well-defined. 

Applicants must be children of registered construction workers in Madhya Pradesh. 

The age limit for applicants is set between 14 to 20 years. 

There is no income ceiling specified for the parents of the applicants. 

However, the parents must possess a valid registration as construction workers under the Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Act, 1996. 

To apply for the Mukhyamantri Nirman Shramikon Ke Bachon Hetu Nihshulk Coaching Sahaayata Yojana, applicants must follow a structured process. 

The first step involves obtaining the application form from the official website or the local office of the Labour Department. 

Applicants must fill out the form with accurate details. 

The required documents include a copy of the parent's construction worker registration certificate. 

Additionally, applicants must provide proof of age such as a birth certificate or school leaving certificate. 

A recent passport-sized photograph of the applicant is also necessary. 

Once the application form is completed, it must be submitted to the local Labour Department office. 

The deadline for submitting applications is typically set for 30 days from the date of announcement of the scheme. 

After submission, the applications are verified by the concerned authorities. 

Eligible candidates are then selected based on the verification process. 

The disbursement of funds is done directly to the coaching institutes. 

This ensures that the financial assistance is utilized for the intended purpose. 

The coaching institutes are required to be recognized and registered under the relevant educational authorities. 

The scheme is implemented by the Labour Department of Madhya Pradesh. 

The department is responsible for monitoring and evaluating the progress of the scheme. 

They also handle the disbursement of funds and ensure compliance with the guidelines. 

The contact details for the Labour Department can be found on the official Madhya Pradesh government website. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from various stakeholders. 

Parents of construction workers have expressed gratitude for the financial support. 

Educational institutions have also welcomed the initiative as it promotes inclusivity. 

The government aims to expand the scheme in the coming years. 

Future plans include increasing the budget allocation to accommodate more beneficiaries. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Madhya Pradesh government to uplift marginalized communities. 

It aligns with the national goals of improving access to education for all. 

The Mukhyamantri Nirman Shramikon Ke Bachon Hetu Nihshulk Coaching Sahaayata Yojana is a significant step towards achieving educational equity. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of skill development among youth. 

By providing coaching for competitive exams, the government aims to empower the next generation. 

This initiative is expected to contribute to the overall socio-economic development of the state. 

The government is committed to ensuring that no child is left behind in the pursuit of education. 

Regular updates regarding the scheme are provided on the official government portal. 

Stakeholders are encouraged to stay informed about any changes or enhancements to the scheme. 

The Mukhyamantri Nirman Shramikon Ke Bachon Hetu Nihshulk Coaching Sahaayata Yojana is a crucial intervention for the children of construction workers. 

It provides them with the necessary support to pursue their academic aspirations. 

The scheme reflects the government's dedication to improving the quality of life for laborers and their families. 

In conclusion, the Mukhyamantri Nirman Shramikon Ke Bachon Hetu Nihshulk Coaching Sahaayata Yojana is a well-structured initiative. 

It aims to provide educational support to a vulnerable section of society. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to social welfare and education. 

Through this initiative, the government hopes to create a more equitable society. 

The Mukhyamantri Nirman Shramikon Ke Bachon Hetu Nihshulk Coaching Sahaayata Yojana is an essential step towards achieving this goal.
